events.title: Vienna Hosts The 70th Eurovision Song Contest
events.summary: The 70th Eurovision Song Contest was held in Vienna, with the Grand Final on May 16, 2026.
events.context: Vienna hosted Eurovision for the third time, staging the contest at the Wiener Stadthalle.
events.whyItMatters: Eurovision is one of Europe's largest shared cultural broadcasts and a recurring marker of music, television, identity, and soft power.

events.title: The 79th Festival De Cannes Takes Place
events.summary: The 79th Festival de Cannes took place from May 12 to 23, 2026.
events.context: Cannes is one of the central annual institutions of international cinema, film markets, and festival culture.
events.whyItMatters: The festival shapes film distribution, critical attention, awards momentum, and global cinema discourse.
